content.content: Documents are checked against their schemas by a JSON Schema validator: the `jsonschema` crate compiles the draft 2020-12 schema the binary carries and checks a serde-decoded document against it, in-process, never by hand-rolled validation.
content.rationale: The Rust stack (I1) names a JSON Schema validator and the serde choice (I1-serde) fixes the JSON layer it sits on; pinning the one crate keeps every checked-in schema checked by the same validator with the same draft support, and keeps schema semantics out of hand-written code.
